webhooks.detail: Webhooks for subscribed events (e.g. Lead Form responses via Lead Notification Subscriptions API); only for apps with approved webhook use case. Ads reporting is pull-only.

evidence.quote: Webhooks allow you to receive real-time HTTP notifications for subscribed events.

sandbox.detail: Development tier lets you create 1 test Ad Account via API; no separate sandbox environment documented. Real ad accounts must be made in Campaign Manager.

evidence.quote: Create : Access to create 1 test Ad Account through the API.

rate_limits.summary: Per-app and per-member daily (24h, reset midnight UTC) limits, 429 on exceed; standard values not published (see Developer Portal Analytics); ads reporting 45M metric values per 5 min

evidence.quote: Rate limits specify the maximum number of API calls that can be made in a 24 hour period.
